summary: Advanced Matka gambling app with real money functionality
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Dark Matka gambling app logo with a spinning wheel and gold lettering on a deep red background (matka-logo.dim_256x256.png)
- Decorative Matka wheel banner with gold and red tones on dark background for hero section (matka-hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png)

existing_features.title: Create an Admin panel page accessible only to the canister controller/admin principal. Admin can: declare game results for active markets, manage market open/close schedules, view all pending deposit and withdrawal requests, approve or reject deposit/withdrawal requests, and view overall platform statistics (total bets, total payout, active users).

Build a Market Lobby page showing all active Matka markets (e.g., Kalyan, Milan Day, Rajdhani Night). Each market card must display: market name, open time, close time, last result (open digit + Jodi + close digit), and current market status (betting open / waiting for result / result declared). Users must be logged in via Internet Identity to place bets.

Build a Bet Placement page for each market. The page must support all bet types: Single (open/close digit 0–9), Jodi (00–99), Single Panna, Double Panna, and Triple Panna. User selects bet type, enters their number selection, enters bet amount (minimum ₹10), and submits. Show current wallet balance and deduct it immediately on successful bet. Display a confirmation with expected payout.

Build a Wallet page where users can: view current balance in INR, submit a deposit request (amount + UTR/transaction reference number), submit a withdrawal request (amount + UPI ID or bank details), and view the full transaction history including bet placements, winnings, deposits, and withdrawals with statuses.

Build a My Bets / Results page showing the authenticated user's full bet history. Each row shows: market name, bet type, selected number, bet amount, result (win/loss/pending), and payout amount. Group bets by date with the most recent first.

Apply a bold Indian gambling/Matka visual theme across the entire app. Use a dark background with deep red and gold as primary accent colors, traditional Matka wheel/playing card motifs, bold typography for numbers and results, and a responsive mobile-first layout. Replace all APK-related branding, copy, and navigation with Matka-specific equivalents.

new_feature_requests.summary: Advanced Matka app with real money betting

Rebuild the backend as a Matka gambling platform actor. Replace all existing APK-related logic with: user registration and profile management (username, balance in paise as Nat), deposit and withdrawal request tracking, Matka game result management (open/close numbers, Jodi, Panna), bet placement with market types (Single, Jodi, Single Panna, Double Panna, Triple Panna), and result declaration with automatic payout calculation based on standard Matka odds.
